issues.name: Early blight
ipm_steps: Remove lower infected leaves and prune to improve airflow.
Mulch the soil to reduce splash of spores from the ground.
Avoid overhead irrigation and water early in the day.
Use copper or other registered foliar protectant as recommended locally.

issues.name: Septoria leaf spot
ipm_steps: Prune and thin the canopy to reduce humidity.
Remove infected lower leaves and keep foliage dry.
Rotate away from solanaceous crops and reduce splash risk.
Apply registered fungicide if disease pressure is high.

issues.name: Blossom-end rot
ipm_steps: Maintain even soil moisture with regular irrigation.
Avoid sudden drought or overwatering cycles.
Use balanced calcium nutrition and avoid root stress.
Remove badly affected fruits and monitor remaining fruit.

prevention: Keep the canopy open and avoid overhead watering.
Scout weekly and remove infected leaves promptly.
